name: SEG
recent: SEG International 在2026年11月19日公布季度业绩，并宣布提供财务援助。新闻指出其2026财年第三季税前利润同比增长57.6%，主要由于学生人数增加。此外，SEGi University 计划将临床医学分校从 Sibu 迁至 Klang。
notable: 公布2026财年第三季业绩，税前利润同比增长57.6%。
SEGi University 计划将临床医学分校从 Sibu 迁至 Klang。
earnings: 2026财年第三季（截至2026年6月30日）营收为 MYR 58.099 million，环比下降0.6%，同比增长18.5%；净收入为 MYR 3.464 million，环比增长15.2%，同比增长1302.4%；净利率为6.0%，高于上一季度的5.1%。

recent_en: SEG International announced quarterly results and provision of financial assistance on 19 Nov 2026. News reported that its 3Q FY2026 profit before tax jumped 57.6% year-on-year on higher enrolment. Additionally, SEGi University plans to relocate its medical clinical campus from Sibu to Klang.
notable_en: Announced 3Q FY2026 results with profit before tax up 57.6% year-on-year.
SEGi University plans to move medical clinical campus from Sibu to Klang.
earnings_en: For 3Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was MYR 58.099 million, down 0.6% QoQ but up 18.5% YoY; net income was MYR 3.464 million, up 15.2% QoQ and up 1302.4% YoY; net margin was 6.0%, higher than 5.1% in the previous quarter.
